items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Babe, that's a doorbell. I don't want to keep you long, but we'll be through here in a few minutes. Did you play with me?

ctx.x: They used, uh, Nora Holt. Played at the Everly Club for years.
Babe, that's a doorbell. I don't want to keep you long, but we'll be through here in a few minutes. Did you play with me?
The bell right. The bell right. Oh, I can't go.
